patterns.usage_note: The formal written counterpart of で for the place, time, or domain in which something takes place: 国際会議において, 教育の分野において. Sibling で is the everyday form of that same job, and にして is the literary 〜で of fixed turns such as 幸いにして. で's other duties do not transfer: tool, material, and cause stay with で (はさみで切る, 風邪で休む). における and においての are the shapes used before a noun.

examples.ruby: 開会式[かいかいしき]は市民[しみん]ホールにおいて行[おこな]われる。
examples.english: The opening ceremony will be held at the civic hall.

examples.ruby: 医療[いりょう]の分野[ぶんや]において、人工知能[じんこうちのう]の活用[かつよう]が進[すす]む。
examples.english: In the medical field, the use of artificial intelligence is advancing.

examples.ruby: 弟[おとうと]は水泳[すいえい]において誰[だれ]にも負[ま]けない。
examples.english: When it comes to swimming, my little brother is second to none.

glosses: as it turns out; as luck would have it
patterns.usage_note: Frames the circumstance an event fell under, a literary で surviving in fixed adverbials: 幸いにして and 不幸にして for how things happened to turn out, 今にして思えば for what is understood only afterwards. Sibling senses take an all-at-once span, 一瞬にして, and emphasis on an age or an attempt, 五十にして, 三度目にして. Nouns only, and rare outside these set turns; a neutral in or at is carried by において or で.

examples.ruby: 幸[さいわ]いにして、けが人[にん]は一人[ひとり]も出[で]なかった。
examples.english: As luck would have it, not one person was hurt.

examples.ruby: 今[いま]にして思[おも]えば、あれは別[わか]れの言葉[ことば]だった。
examples.english: Looking back on it now, those were words of farewell.

examples.ruby: 不幸[ふこう]にして、その計画[けいかく]は途中[とちゅう]で頓挫[とんざ]した。
examples.english: As ill luck would have it, the plan stalled partway through.

patterns.usage_note: Names the place or setting an action happens in: 駅で待つ, カフェで勉強する, 世界で一番, and での before a noun (東京での生活). Sibling で entries: means, material or cause (筆で書く, 風邪で休む), price or standard (半額で), group as doer (会社で), copula linking form (休みで), te-form joint (呼んで). Existence with いる and ある takes に (家にいる), but an event held somewhere takes で (公園でお祭りがある).

examples.ruby: 駅[えき]の前[まえ]で友[とも]だちと待[ま]ち合[あ]わせた。
examples.english: I met up with my friend in front of the station.

examples.ruby: 昨日[きのう]はカフェで三時間[さんじかん]も勉強[べんきょう]した。
examples.english: Yesterday I studied at a cafe for a good three hours.

examples.ruby: 母[はは]は台所[だいどころ]で味噌汁[みそしる]を作[つく]っている。
examples.english: My mother is making miso soup in the kitchen.
